last_source_review.scope: Swapchain XML comparison, presence of the identity/refresh/VRR/tearing/focus/root-HDR properties consumed by MAKO, and the VRR/tearing property-change handlers.
last_source_review.result: Swapchain XML is byte-identical to the protocol source revision. Reviewed root-property names remain present; VRR and tearing property changes still update the compositor preferences. Scheduling behavior, gamescope_control, full WSI, Steam client behavior, and physical presentation were not qualified by this source review.
